$comment: STEM QUEST Fill/Complete correct answer (Task 3.2). Acceptable responses per blank. Explicit tolerance; no vague fuzzy matching. Server-only. The `answers` (text) group is optional: number-only and expression-only questions need no text entries. Per-blank coverage and type-match are enforced by the engine plugin (catalog rule fill-complete.blanks-referenced).

accepted.description: Exact, normalized (trim + case-fold) accepted strings. No fuzzy substring matching.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance; answers within value ± tolerance are correct.

min.description: Accepted range lower bound (overrides value/tolerance when present).

max.description: Accepted range upper bound (overrides value/tolerance when present).

step.description: Optional granularity; comparison uses value±tolerance, not step.

accepted.description: Canonical string forms (e.g. ["x^2","x*x"]). Compared after whitespace normalization only.
